content: The superior man is modest in his speech, but exceeds in his actions.
author: Confucius
explanation: Confucius contrasts the shallow bluster of those who boast with the quiet power of the Junzi (noble person). True worth demonstrates itself through measurable, dependable deeds rather than inflated promises.
practicalInsight: Under-promise and over-deliver in your commitments today; let the quality of your finished work speak on your behalf.
reflectionPrompt: Where have your words outpaced your tangible actions, and how can you restore harmony between what you say and do?
